name: cable kneeling single arm horizontal row
description: A one-arm cable row from a kneeling position. Kneeling removes leg drive so your back does the pulling.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
